d:
The party wasn’t over yet.
The Masters took turns joining in, letting the pups play with one another.
The party only grew more intense, until everyone was completely lost in it...

Thank you all for your patience!
The final art pack of the year is complete!
Wishing everyone a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!
n: [Artist CG] 【Yetigo】《Kisho the Dog Slave》22 Pet Party (英文 English)
